name: Nigeria

fees.name: e-Visa (Short Visit, single entry - tourism/business/visiting, F4A/F5A/F6A)
fees.validity: 90 days from issuance; stay up to 30 days (tourism) / 90 days, single entry
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (177 countries; ECOWAS citizens visa-free)
fees.notes: Launched 1 May 2025 under Nigeria Visa Policy 2025, replacing visa on arrival. Fee is reciprocity-based and varies by nationality; the exact amount is computed and paid online on the NIS portal during application. See reciprocity_variations for the published per-country schedule (NIS reciprocity table). Third-party guides report e.g. USD 160 for US nationals, consistent with the NIS table.

fees.name: Embassy short-visit visa (single entry) - reciprocity schedule
fees.applies: nationals of ~25 countries not eligible for e-visa; fee varies by nationality
fees.notes: Nigeria publishes a per-country reciprocity fee table (Embassy VISA Fees, immigration.gov.ng/visa-fees; archived copy via cscs.ng dated 19/06/2019, still the last published schedule). Single-entry fees range from gratis (e.g. ECOWAS, Singapore, Barbados) to USD 253 (India, Bangladesh). No single flat fee exists; see reciprocity_variations.

fees.name: Business visa (single entry F4A / multiple entry F4B)
fees.validity: single entry 90 days; multiple-entry 1/2/5-year options for some nationalities
fees.applies: all non-exempt nationalities; fee varies by nationality (reciprocity)
fees.notes: Same reciprocity schedule as short-visit visas; multiple-entry fees are higher (e.g. UK: USD 472/1yr, USD 944/2yr, USD 2360/5yr; Canada USD 150; Russia USD 200 per the NIS table).

fees.name: Transit visa (F3B)
fees.notes: Applied for via the e-visa portal; fee is nationality-dependent and shown at payment on the NIS portal. No flat published amount on an official static page; third-party sources cite ~USD 80 but this is unverified.

fees.name: Visa on Arrival (discontinued)
fees.notes: VoA was phased out from 1 May 2025 and replaced by the e-Visa under Nigeria Visa Policy 2025. Before discontinuation the VoA biometric fee was USD 170 (waived for US nationals from March 2023, per Fragomen).

reciprocity_variations.note: single AND multiple entry USD 253 (NIS Embassy Visa Fees reciprocity table)
single entry and multiple entry (1-2 yr) all USD 160; no 5-year option
single entry USD 144; multiple entry USD 472 (1yr) / 944 (2yr) / 2360 (5yr)
single entry USD 68; no multiple entry
single entry USD 39; multiple entry USD 78
single entry USD 84; multiple entry USD 200
single entry USD 75; multiple entry USD 150

vfs.service_fee: USD 96.30 (USA centres; USD 60 for US citizens); CAD 139 (Canada; CAD 79.50 for US citizens); EUR 91.45 (Germany)
vfs.note: Nigeria visa applications route through VFS Global in at least USA, Canada, Germany and the Philippines (per our data/vfs corridors). Mandatory service fee paid at the centre, on top of the visa fee paid online on the NIS portal; amounts vary by centre. In the UK/US some routes use OIS Services instead.

free_visa_notes: ECOWAS citizens (15 West African states) are visa-free. Several other nationalities are gratis on the reciprocity table (e.g. Afghanistan, Barbados, Liberia, Macedonia, Sierra Leone, Singapore, Trinidad and Tobago).
